blocking_findings: Controller selection is read once and then copied into a private config without post-read source SHA, sole PID/argv, socket peer or selection recheck. This violates the bounded controller identity contract and leaves a current-leaf TOCTOU gap. Requery just before private write and compare the leaf in memory without logging its name; recheck all identities.

source_structure checks external-file-like keys only at the top of each proxy object. Ten of 15 current exact-source nodes have nested dict/list values. The selected leaf may change to one of them; recursive external reference and supported-type checks are required before copying the entire object.

The credential-bearing mihomo -t subprocess has no demonstrated no-network confinement or network observation. The no-gz02/no-network statement is an intent/fixture boundary, not proven for a real selected node. Either establish an exact binary/source-backed offline contract or place a bounded network-denial/observation gate that respects the no-container/no-namespace rule.

subprocess.run timeout kills the direct mihomo -t process but does not prove descendants are terminated. The runner deletes its private directory after the command, so any surviving child could retain or use stale config. Use a process-group termination/readback and fail closed if descendants remain.
limits: One-shot START and ordinary-exception cleanup are coded, but forced SIGKILL or host loss can leave a private 0600 credential file; no automatic replay.
Mock syntax success does not establish real Hysteria2/VLESS/TUIC/VMess selected-node syntax or egress.
No v2b listener/routing or v2c SSH/remote identity evidence.
next_release: Do not issue ISSUE_EXACT_V2A_SYNTAX_ONCE for this v1 runner. Revise and independently retest identity freshness, recursive selected-node schema, bounded offline execution and descendant cleanup first; then a single v2a syntax-only root release may be considered. Keep v2b/v2c separate.
